Maya Chen: Starting a compact admin-mapping sample for infra + prod-analytics. Goal: spot ownerless bindings, impersonation chains, and KMS exposures. Icho CSV here when done.
Carlos Rivera: ETA?
Maya Chen: ~3h. Running `./iam-scan --groups infra,prod-analytics --include-impersonation --kms-bindings --format csv`.
Nate Brooks: flag service-account impersonation chains crossing projects as high-risk (we missed a chain last cycle).
Samir Patel: proposal: auto-create tickets with `justification_age` and `last_active` columns. For canary runs only, allow `auto_remediate: true` when risk_reason matches safe-prune rules.
Elle Johnson: playbook for ownerless bindings: 1) notify owners list 2) 72h response window 3) if none, low-blast-radius canary prune 4) 24h monitor + revert if failures. Include revert token in the ticket.
Maya Chen: agree. Revert snippet for runbook: `iam-grant --revert --ticket $T --principal $P --role $R --reason "revert temp-prune"`.
sec-automation-bot: scan started for infra,prod-analytics. est 7m.
sec-automation-bot: scan complete. summary: 28 elevated principals, 4 ownerless admin bindings, 6 grants stale >200d. CSV: https://files.redwood/priv-snapshots/1705002468.csv
Carlos Rivera: if any KMS grants touch external projects add KMSSurface and kms-rotation watchers to the ticket.
Maya Chen: added watchers. Scheduling a canary subset prune Fri 09:00 UTC; will notify infra, analytics, and oncall. Ping me here if you have critical jobs to exclude. :eyes:
